@allure.title("Test Login and Sign Out from Autoliv Dashboard")
    @allure.severity(allure.severity_level.CRITICAL)
    def test_login_and_sign_out():
        options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
        options.add_argument("--start-maximized")
        driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=options)
    
        try:
            with allure.step("Open Login Page"):
                driver.get("https://alv-vicas.livnsense.com/#/auth/login")
                WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//input[@placeholder='Username']"))
                )
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="login_page_loaded",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            with allure.step("Enter Credentials and Sign In"):
                username = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//input[@placeholder='Username']")
                username.clear()
                username.send_keys("madan")
    
                password = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//input[@placeholder='Password']")
                password.clear()
                password.send_keys("Madan@123")
    
                sign_in = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//button[contains(text(), 'Sign In')]")
                sign_in.click()
    
            with allure.step("Wait for Autoliv Dashboard"):
                WebDriverWait(driver, 30).until(
                    EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//img[@alt='Autoliv']"))
                )
                logo = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, "//img[@alt='Autoliv']")
                assert logo.is_displayed(), "Autoliv logo is not visible at the top left."
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="dashboard_loaded",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            with allure.step("Select 'AIB' from project dropdown"):
                dropdown = WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.presence_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "div.region-container select.dropdown"))
                )
                select = Select(dropdown)
                selected_option = select.first_selected_option
                if selected_option.text.strip() != "AIB":
                    select.select_by_visible_text("AIB")
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="project_selected",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            with allure.step("Validate 'AIB' project loaded"):
                selected_option = select.first_selected_option
                assert "AIB" in selected_option.text.strip(), '"AIB" project was not loaded successfully.'
    
            with allure.step("Click profile dropdown"):
                dropdown_icon = WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "div.profile-img div.dropdown-icon"))
                )
                # Scroll into view if needed
                driver.execute_script("arguments[0].scrollIntoView(true);", dropdown_icon)
                time.sleep(0.5)
                dropdown_icon.click()
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="dropdown_clicked",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
            with allure.step("Handle sign out confirmation dialog"):
                # Wait for the dialog to appear
                WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(
                    EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "app-dialog-box"))
                )
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="signout_dialog",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
                # Click the sign-out button in the dialog
                sign_out_btn = WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(
                    EC.element_to_be_clickable((By.CSS_SELECTOR, "button.sign-out-btn"))
                )
                sign_out_btn.click()
    
            with allure.step("Verify redirected to login page"):
                WebDriverWait(driver, 20).until(
                    EC.url_contains("auth/login")
                )
                allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                              name="signout_success",
                              attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
    
        except Exception as e:
            allure.attach(driver.get_screenshot_as_png(),
                          name="test_failure",
                          attachment_type=AttachmentType.PNG)
